title: Collapsible
description: One disclosure on its own: a trigger row and the region it folds away. The Accordion is this, grouped.
usage: For the single "show more" a page needs once — advanced options, a long answer, the fine print. It is a native details element: no script, and it stays exactly as open or closed as the markup says. For a stack of them, use Accordion.
a11y: The summary is a real disclosure control: keyboard-operable, with its state announced. Keep the trigger text meaningful on its own ("Advanced options", not "More").
